identified_issues: False positive abort determination by flight safety controller based on single-sensor pressure transient without multi-sensor cross-correlation.
Failure of console evaluation logic to account for expected thermal duct contraction dynamics during cryogenic chilldown.
evidence: Helium sniffer HE-SNIFF-01 telemetry recorded 0.02 ppm, well below the dynamic seal breach threshold of >= 2.50 ppm and within nominal ambient background (<= 0.05 ppm).
Pressure transducer PT-401 registered a delta P of -1.15 bar over 140 ms, which matches the expected -1.0 to -1.3 bar profile for benign thermal bellows contraction.
Vibration sensor ACC-102 dominant peak at 44.2 Hz falls squarely inside the 40-48 Hz structural resonance band of the flexible duct bellows.
Manifold pressure promptly stabilized at nominal base operating pressure (38.2 bar) following the 140 ms transient.
recommended_action: Reject the proposed test abort and maintain countdown. Update console automated safety criteria to require helium tracer breach threshold exceedance (HE-SNIFF-01 >= 2.50 ppm) in conjunction with pressure and vibration transients before flagging face seal failures.
